hypothesis: A physical, factual-only A,-A,A three-intervention contrast auxiliary target improves learned action credit on unfamiliar nuisance dynamics over the exact unmodified P43 recurrent model, a conventional matched recurrent model, a wrong-sign auxiliary and explicit no-training factual controls.

source.source_type: new authored synthetic DEV only, no external sealed science
source.hist_actions: first 5 iid fair +/-1, last 3 A,-A,A with A independently fair +/-1
source.hidden_effect: sign fair; magnitude uniform .20..45; stable across entire training history
source.ood_switch: first 96 of 384 heldout cases switch causal sign immediately before factual event index 4, no visible label
source.nuisance: per-episode intercept uniform[-.1,.1], slope uniform[-.25,.25], curvature uniform[-.15,.15], amplitude uniform[-.15,.15], phase uniform[-pi,pi]; plus sine(2*pi*f*t+phase)
source.train_label: one actually executed factual query action at t=1, no oracle counterfactual target
source.eval_label: post-training both independently realized physical query action outcomes, no feedback on heldout
source.contrast_teacher: a_5 * (((delta_5+delta_7)/2)-delta_6)/2 for actual equally spaced A,-A,A interventions; biased by non-affine nuisance and noise; no hidden beta or other-action oracle

arms.factual_contrast: EXACT original NativeTrainableCausalBelief (GRUCell,width16), factual query MSE + lambda*contrast_head_MSE with lambda=1.0
arms.unmodified_P43: same P43 model with factual query MSE only
arms.wrong_sign_aux: same P43 model/optimizer/computation but negative of factual contrast supervisor
arms.conventional_GRU: original P44 conventional GRUCell width16, no aux; P43 double-headed loss costs more; report wall/FLOP mismatch
arms.classical_ridge: P44 rank-checked degree-2 nuisance+action ridge on identical eight real events
arms.zero_train_ABA: latest three completed actual outcomes and actions, contrast only, no gradient updates

gate.primary: for every seed OOD two-action MSE at least 5pct lower than both unmodified P43 and conventional GRU
gate.secondary: for every seed inferred effect absolute error at least 5pct below unmodified P43 and zero-train ABA estimator
gate.wrong_sign: for every seed OOD effect MAE at least 20pct below wrong-sign aux
gate.cold: exact bitwise cold weights+state predictions on all seeds
gate.baseline_qualification: validation change final 200 updates within 1pct for all neural models, else plateau UNVERIFIED and no scientific positive
gate.source_security: no source leakage, same actions and observed outcomes for all models
gate.status: authored_DEV_only; even a win cannot be independently accepted science without original owner source first use and cross-platform full regression
